# Switch

On/off toggle that takes effect immediately (settings), not a form choice to submit later.

`KenosUI.Switch` · Forms

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Switch />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Switch"></x-import>
```

## Props (SwitchProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Track 24–48px wide. Default "md". |
| `palette` | `"primary" \| "accent"` | Checked track colour. Default "primary". |
| `label` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, "size">._
